newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Several wounded at Albania election rally-witness.
newsitem.headline: Several wounded at Albania election rally-witness.

text.p: Several people were wounded on Thursday by gunfire during a rally held by Albanian President Sali Berisha, just three days before a snap general election, witnesses said.

Foreign journalists who attended the rally in Lushnje, about 80 km (50 miles) south of the capital Tirana, said shooting broke out outside the town hall where Berisha was addressing a crowd of several hundred. One journalist said she saw at least eight people with injuries in the town hospital.
